<!-- What does this change, and why? Name the decision records (ADRs) and build-plan chunks it touches. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the Developer Certificate of Origin.
- [ ] `cargo xtask lint` and `cargo xtask test` pass locally.
- [ ] New files carry their SPDX tags, and new files in a crate's `tests/` are declared in its `Cargo.toml`.
- [ ] Documents and diagrams changed by this follow the conventions in CONTRIBUTING.md.
